name: Recomp Achievements Online
description: An add-on for Recomp Achievements that sends your leaderboard card to the community leaderboard when you save, instead of copying it out by hand. Link a save to Discord with /link and the code on the card. Sends the card's game, trainer name, points, play time, save ID and check code, plus a random key kept in the save. Nothing is sent to RetroAchievements. Needs Recomp Achievements.
